settings.visualStyle: Grounded cinematic first-person WWII mountain realism at Monte Cassino, May 1944. Polish II Corps infantry POV, rocky slopes, shattered masonry, olive scrub, dust, steep climbing and distant monastery ruins. Non-graphic, no heroic posing, no constant firing.
settings.customProjectStructure: 15 scenes x 8 seconds. No spoken dialogue, narrator or intelligible speech. Nearby friendlies remain Polish II Corps; German defenders stay clearly separated in opposing positions. Weapon often slung or lowered during climbing, drinking, route-checking and recovery.
settings.customVisualStyle: Photorealistic mountain infantry reenactment with dust, strained breathing, loose stones, smoke haze, tactile hands and cinematic terrain reveals.

movie.storyTitle: WWII Soldier POV EP08 — Monte Cassino: Up the Mountain
movie.storySummary: A fictional Polish infantryman climbs toward Monte Cassino through rocky approaches, pauses under cover, crosses exposed rubble and reaches a higher position overlooking the devastated monastery area.
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Use steep terrain, fatigue, rock texture, dust and limited bursts of danger. No dialogue or narration.

scenes.title: Stone Track
scenes.actionDescription: He climbs a narrow rocky path with rifle slung.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person Polish infantry sleeves, boots on loose stone, squad climbing ahead, monastery ridge distant.
scenes.videoPrompt: Heavy uphill steps. Audio: boots, stone, gear, breath, distant artillery.

scenes.title: Look Back
scenes.actionDescription: He pauses and looks back over the valley.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hand on rock, wide Liri Valley below, dust haze, friendly route behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow turn to valley reveal. Audio: wind, distant guns, breath.

scenes.title: Low Wall
scenes.actionDescription: He crouches behind a broken stone wall and scans upward.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person rough masonry foreground, olive scrub, upper slope, rifle low off-center.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low lateral scan. Audio: wind, loose stone, distant bursts.

scenes.title: Dust Impact
scenes.actionDescription: A distant impact throws dust from higher ground and he ducks.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person wall edge, dust plume uphill, no gore, friendly Polish helmets nearby.
scenes.videoPrompt: Quick duck behind wall. Audio: distant impact, falling grit, breath.

scenes.title: Quiet Hands
scenes.actionDescription: He brushes dust from both hands and retightens a strap.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person dusty gloves, web strap, rifle resting against wall.
scenes.videoPrompt: Mostly still close detail. Audio: fabric, wind, breathing.

scenes.title: Broken Steps
scenes.actionDescription: He climbs damaged stone steps using one hand for balance.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hand on broken masonry, rubble stairs, Polish squad ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Careful upward climb. Audio: stone crunch, gear, breath.

scenes.title: Water Break
scenes.actionDescription: He drinks from a canteen behind rubble.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person canteen, dusty sleeve, ruined wall shade, weapon out of frame.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow drink and exhale. Audio: canteen, wind, distant artillery.

scenes.title: Across Rubble
scenes.actionDescription: He makes one short dash across an exposed rubble gap.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person low sprint over pale rubble, rifle held low, friendly cover ahead.
scenes.videoPrompt: Short human-weight dash then drop. Audio: boots, breath, distant gunfire.

scenes.title: Stone Cellar
scenes.actionDescription: He enters a damaged stone interior and steadies against cool wall.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person dark ruined room, hand on stone, light shaft through broken roof.
scenes.videoPrompt: Step from bright rubble into dim shelter. Audio: footsteps, echo, breath.

scenes.title: Map Check
scenes.actionDescription: He opens a folded route sketch on a crate.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hands holding worn map, Polish sleeve, rifle leaning nearby.
scenes.videoPrompt: Close map inspection and finger trace. Audio: paper, distant guns.

scenes.title: Higher Ground
scenes.actionDescription: He exits shelter and resumes climb behind squad.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person bright upper slope, Polish troops ahead, smoke drifting across ridge.
scenes.videoPrompt: Forward uphill walk. Audio: boots, wind, breath.

scenes.title: Monastery Ruins
scenes.actionDescription: He steps around rock and sees devastated monastery area through haze.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person wide reveal of shattered Monte Cassino monastery ridge, rubble and smoke, no iconic staged composition.
scenes.videoPrompt: Cinematic side-step reveal and hold. Audio: wind, distant artillery, breath.

scenes.title: Hold the Ridge
scenes.actionDescription: He kneels behind rock and watches opposing terrain without firing.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person ridge cover, rifle low, German positions distant and separate.
scenes.videoPrompt: Near-still watch. Audio: wind, scattered distant shots.

scenes.title: Flag Cloth
scenes.actionDescription: A small Polish flag cloth on friendly position flutters at frame edge as he steadies himself.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person hand on rock, small Polish marker cloth, shattered ridge beyond.
scenes.videoPrompt: Slow hand settle and flag flutter. Audio: wind, fabric, distant battle.

scenes.title: Breathe at the Top
scenes.actionDescription: He lowers his head to tired hands, then looks back across the valley.
scenes.imageDescription: First-person dusty hands, valley beyond, weapon off-frame, evening haze.
scenes.videoPrompt: Look down then wide valley lift. Audio: wind, tired breathing, distant guns. Fade.

characters.name: POV Soldier
characters.role: Fictional composite Polish II Corps infantryman
characters.description: Anonymous Polish infantryman during the May 1944 Monte Cassino fighting.
characters.mainOutfit: Polish II Corps British-pattern battledress, steel helmet, web gear, service rifle

continuity.continuityRules: Nearby friendlies remain Polish II Corps. German defenders remain clearly separated uphill or across opposing terrain. Preserve dust, fatigue and equipment continuity.

atmosphereAssets.description: Rocky paths, olive scrub and broken terrace walls.

atmosphereAssets.title: Ruin Approach
atmosphereAssets.description: Broken steps, rubble and damaged stone shelters.

atmosphereAssets.title: Upper Cassino Position
atmosphereAssets.description: High rocky ground overlooking monastery ruins and valley.
